recruit: Recruit 8 people from the segment who buy a functional or better-for-you product at least weekly.
markers: Follows a fitness or wellness brand
questions: Walk me through the last time you bought something like this. What made you pick it?
What would a product like this need to do for the price to feel right to you?
How do you decide whether a health claim on a label is worth paying for?
When would you reach for this instead of what you drink now?
What, if anything, would stop you from trying it a second time?
